items.name: openpencil
items.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.

items.name: pencilplaybook
items.description: PencilPlaybook is the UI Skills / Taste-Skill for Pencil.dev + Claude Code — a design playbook that gives Claude real perceptual psychology and senior-level guardrails so it stops producing averaged-out AI slop.

items.name: MusePro
items.description: MusePro is the next generation of drawing tools - a professional-grade app for iOS and visionOS where your Apple Pencil strokes guide real-time AI image generation.

items.name: ai-finance-pencil
items.description: A versatile personal finance management tool, ai-finance-pencil combines Django Rest Framework and Next.js to provide an intuitive UI for tracking income and expenses. Enhanced with OpenAI's GPT-3 for interactive insights, budgeting tips, and chat support.

items.name: Image-To-Sketch
items.description: This Is An Advanced AI Model Which Can Convert Any Image (As Per Your Input) To Pencil Sketch Image...

items.name: blender-mcp
items.description: Blender 3D automation via FastMCP 3.2 — 41 portmanteau tools, 150+ operations. AI construction, VRM avatars, Gaussian splats, VSE video editing, Grease Pencil 2D animation, Tauri 2.0 desktop. React dashboard.

items.name: Parkinsons-Detection
items.description: An AI-based mobile application that is able to diagnose Parkinson's Disease using two independent tests that require only a pencil and a paper. Based on the 2017 research paper Distinguishing Different Stages of Parkinson's Disease Using Composite Index of Speed and Pen-Pressure of Sketching a Spiral by Zham et. al. The trained models were deployed using a Flask backend server, along with a Flutter based frontend mobile application frontend to interact with the REST API.

items.name: pencil-skill
items.description: AI coding skill plugin for pencil.dev (.pen) design files via the Pencil MCP server — works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI

items.name: AI-Sketches-a-Photo
items.description: An AI that reads a photo passed to it, and recreates the photo into a black and white pencil sketch

items.name: dev-roast
items.description: AI code roasting app with terminal aesthetics. Built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4 & TypeScript — designed in Pencil (MCP) and coded with Claude Code + Claude Opus 4.6 + Superpowers.
